_comment: Behavioural-eval coverage ratchet floor (road-to-skill-eval-coverage Phase 3). skill_eval_coverage --check fails if coverage drops below these counts. Regenerate with `--write-floor` ONLY after authoring evals — the floor only rises. LOWERING POLICY: a legitimate drop (skills merged, redundant eval removed) is allowed ONLY by editing a count downward WITH a logged reason in coverage-floor.README.md — never by deleting the floor file or a tier key. See coverage-floor.README.md.
